title: Count the frames
prompt: A member `frames` starts at 0. Write `_process`, which takes delta and adds 1 to frames every time it runs. The judge runs 60 frames, then `solve` returns frames.
hints: _process is a function Godot calls for you, again and again.
You do not call it yourself; leave solve as it is.

docs.name: func _process(delta):
docs.what: Godot calls this once per frame, about 60 times a second. delta is the frame time in seconds.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable keeps its value from one frame to the next.
